Compu Movie is a VHS video release made by Osamu Sato & produced by O.S.D. (Out Side Directors Company) and released by Tierrart. Featuring of collection of music videos made using Amiga and Macintosh computers and music by Shinobu Narita, Osamu Sato, and The Sync (produced by Goh Hotoda). The VHS was available to purchase through the company only. Compu Movie was considered lost media for a long time as it had not surfaced in full on the internet.

(Source: lostmediawiki)

The Esoteric Retina is a Video CD release by Japanese artist Osamu Sato, known for creating surrealistic games such as LSD: Dream Emulator. The VCD's rarity was proven to be high and, for years, the disc's contents had not surfaced online. Aside from the fact that it contained several music videos by Sato, little to no info about its contents was known. In February 2018, a copy of The Esoteric Retina was auctioned, and the disc's contents were ripped and made available online in late June 2018.

(Source: lostmediawiki)

Long ago, there lived a young man named Yosuke in the village of Shiiba in Hyuuga.

"I want enough money and possessions to live a luxurious life without having to work"

Yohei abandoned his job in his impoverished village, where only barnyard millet, oxtail millet and beans could be grown. He fled into the mountains, where one night he witnessed a strange sight.

A blue ogre clinging to a large cedar tree split its back, began to shed its skin and quickly transformed into a red ogre. Yosuke stole the shed skin, wore it and began committing crimes in the village.

However, when he tried to take off the skin, he couldn't get it off no matter what he did...

(Source: Official Website, translated)
